{-# LANGUAGE OverloadedStrings #-}
module TokenAuth where

import qualified Data.ByteString as BS
import qualified Data.ByteString.Char8 as BC
import qualified Data.ByteString.Base64.URL as B64
import Data.Aeson (decode, encode, Value(..), Object)
import qualified Data.Aeson as Aeson
import qualified Data.Aeson.Key as Key
import qualified Data.Aeson.KeyMap as KM
import qualified Data.Text as T
import qualified Data.Text.Encoding as TE
import Data.Time.Clock (UTCTime, getCurrentTime, diffUTCTime)
import Data.Time.Clock.POSIX (posixSecondsToUTCTime)
import qualified Crypto.MAC.HMAC as HMAC
import qualified Crypto.Hash as Hash
import Data.Maybe (fromMaybe)
import Data.Word (Word8)
import System.IO (hPutStrLn, stderr)

-- Configuration
data AuthConfig = AuthConfig
  { configSecret    :: BS.ByteString
  , configIssuer    :: T.Text
  , configAudience  :: T.Text
  , configMaxAge    :: Int  -- seconds
  , configAlgorithms :: [T.Text]  -- allowed algorithms
  } deriving (Show)

defaultConfig :: BS.ByteString -> AuthConfig
defaultConfig secret = AuthConfig
  { configSecret = secret
  , configIssuer = "auth.example.com"
  , configAudience = "api.example.com"
  , configMaxAge = 3600
  , configAlgorithms = ["HS256", "HS384", "HS512"]
  }

-- Token structure
data TokenHeader = TokenHeader
  { thAlg :: T.Text
  , thTyp :: T.Text
  } deriving (Show)

data TokenClaims = TokenClaims
  { tcSub :: T.Text
  , tcIss :: T.Text
  , tcAud :: T.Text
  , tcExp :: Integer
  , tcIat :: Integer
  , tcRole :: T.Text
  , tcPerms :: [T.Text]
  } deriving (Show)

data AuthResult
  = AuthSuccess TokenClaims
  | AuthFailure T.Text
  deriving (Show)

-- Parsing helpers
parseHeader :: BS.ByteString -> Maybe TokenHeader
parseHeader bs = do
  let decoded = B64.decodeBase64Lenient bs
  obj <- decode (BS.fromStrict decoded) :: Maybe Object
  algVal <- KM.lookup (Key.fromString "alg") obj
  typVal <- KM.lookup (Key.fromString "typ") obj
  alg <- case algVal of
    String t -> Just t
    _        -> Nothing
  typ <- case typVal of
    String t -> Just t
    _        -> Nothing
  return $ TokenHeader alg typ

parseClaims :: BS.ByteString -> Maybe TokenClaims
parseClaims bs = do
  let decoded = B64.decodeBase64Lenient bs
  obj <- decode (BS.fromStrict decoded) :: Maybe Object
  subVal <- KM.lookup (Key.fromString "sub") obj
  issVal <- KM.lookup (Key.fromString "iss") obj
  audVal <- KM.lookup (Key.fromString "aud") obj
  expVal <- KM.lookup (Key.fromString "exp") obj
  iatVal <- KM.lookup (Key.fromString "iat") obj
  roleVal <- KM.lookup (Key.fromString "role") obj
  sub <- case subVal of { String t -> Just t; _ -> Nothing }
  iss <- case issVal of { String t -> Just t; _ -> Nothing }
  aud <- case audVal of { String t -> Just t; _ -> Nothing }
  expT <- case expVal of { Number n -> Just (round n); _ -> Nothing }
  iat <- case iatVal of { Number n -> Just (round n); _ -> Nothing }
  role <- case roleVal of { String t -> Just t; _ -> Nothing }
  let perms = case KM.lookup (Key.fromString "perms") obj of
        Just (Array arr) -> [t | String t <- foldr (:) [] arr]
        _ -> []
  return $ TokenClaims sub iss aud expT iat role perms

-- Signature verification
computeHMAC256 :: BS.ByteString -> BS.ByteString -> BS.ByteString
computeHMAC256 secret msg =
  BS.pack $ BS.unpack $ HMAC.hmacGetDigest (HMAC.hmac secret msg :: HMAC.HMAC Hash.SHA256)

computeHMAC384 :: BS.ByteString -> BS.ByteString -> BS.ByteString
computeHMAC384 secret msg =
  BS.pack $ BS.unpack $ HMAC.hmacGetDigest (HMAC.hmac secret msg :: HMAC.HMAC Hash.SHA384)

computeHMAC512 :: BS.ByteString -> BS.ByteString -> BS.ByteString
computeHMAC512 secret msg =
  BS.pack $ BS.unpack $ HMAC.hmacGetDigest (HMAC.hmac secret msg :: HMAC.HMAC Hash.SHA512)

constantTimeCompare :: BS.ByteString -> BS.ByteString -> Bool
constantTimeCompare a b
  | BS.length a /= BS.length b = False
  | otherwise = (== 0) $ BS.foldl' (\acc w -> acc + w) 0 $ BS.zipWith xor' a b
  where xor' x y = if x == y then 0 else 1

-- Algorithm validation - strictly reject "none" algorithm
validateAlgorithm :: AuthConfig -> T.Text -> Bool
validateAlgorithm config alg = alg `elem` configAlgorithms config

-- Core verification
verifySignature :: AuthConfig -> TokenHeader -> BS.ByteString -> BS.ByteString -> Bool
verifySignature config header signingInput providedSig =
  if not (validateAlgorithm config (thAlg header))
    then False
    else verifyWithAlg (thAlg header) (configSecret config) signingInput providedSig

verifyWithAlg :: T.Text -> BS.ByteString -> BS.ByteString -> BS.ByteString -> Bool
verifyWithAlg alg secret signingInput providedSig =
  let decodedSig = B64.decodeBase64Lenient providedSig
      computed = case alg of
        "HS256" -> computeHMAC256 secret signingInput
        "HS384" -> computeHMAC384 secret signingInput
        "HS512" -> computeHMAC512 secret signingInput
        _       -> BS.empty
  in constantTimeCompare computed decodedSig

-- Claims validation
validateClaims :: AuthConfig -> UTCTime -> TokenClaims -> Either T.Text TokenClaims
validateClaims config now claims = do
  let expTime = posixSecondsToUTCTime (fromInteger $ tcExp claims)
  let iatTime = posixSecondsToUTCTime (fromInteger $ tcIat claims)
  if diffUTCTime now expTime > 0
    then Left "Token expired"
    else if tcIss claims /= configIssuer config
    then Left "Invalid issuer"
    else if tcAud claims /= configAudience config
    then Left "Invalid audience"
    else if diffUTCTime now iatTime < 0
    then Left "Token issued in the future"
    else if tcRole claims `notElem` ["admin", "user", "service"]
    then Left "Invalid role"
    else Right claims

-- Main authentication function
authenticateToken :: AuthConfig -> UTCTime -> BS.ByteString -> AuthResult
authenticateToken config now tokenBS =
  let parts = BC.split '.' tokenBS
  in case parts of
    [headerB64, claimsB64, sigB64] ->
      let signingInput = headerB64 <> "." <> claimsB64
      in case (parseHeader headerB64, parseClaims claimsB64) of
        (Just header, Just claims) ->
          if verifySignature config header signingInput sigB64
            then case validateClaims config now claims of
              Right validClaims -> AuthSuccess validClaims
              Left err -> AuthFailure err
            else AuthFailure "Invalid signature"
        (Nothing, _) -> AuthFailure "Malformed header"
        (_, Nothing) -> AuthFailure "Malformed claims"
    _ -> AuthFailure "Invalid token format"

-- Request handling
data Request = Request
  { reqPath   :: T.Text
  , reqMethod :: T.Text
  , reqToken  :: BS.ByteString
  } deriving (Show)

data Response = Response
  { respStatus :: Int
  , respBody   :: T.Text
  } deriving (Show)

requiresAdmin :: T.Text -> T.Text -> Bool
requiresAdmin path method =
  T.isPrefixOf "/admin" path || (method == "DELETE" && T.isPrefixOf "/api" path)

handleRequest :: AuthConfig -> UTCTime -> Request -> Response
handleRequest config now req =
  case authenticateToken config now (reqToken req) of
    AuthSuccess claims ->
      if requiresAdmin (reqPath req) (reqMethod req) && tcRole claims /= "admin"
        then Response 403 "Forbidden: admin required"
        else Response 200 ("Welcome, " <> tcSub claims)
    AuthFailure err -> Response 401 ("Unauthorized: " <> err)
